answer: Agents pin identities to sparrow-feather quills soaking in ocean brine; the quill’s vane carries a voyage path encoded in iridescent algae whose bloom must pass a voyage audit. A Sybil forces a new feather, costing 0.42 milligrams of live brine algae lost to evaporation and 11 seconds of sequential bloom-temperature scripting, since bulk algae vats disrupt the brine’s exact micronutrient gradient.
